public.tagline: Plan the event. Run the night.
public.body: Soirely is where an event is planned at a desk and run from a phone. Guests, seating, menus, the running order — in one place, in your language.

status.title: Service status
status.intro: Read live from the API through the shared client, so this page failing means the client or CORS is wrong rather than the page.
status.unreachable: The API could not be reached.

error.title: Something went wrong

notFound.title: This page does not exist

guest.invitationBody: No account is needed. This page is yours for this event.

guest.noAccountNeeded: You do not need an account to reply.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.refused: That email and password do not match. Check both, or reset your password.
signIn.endedBody: Sign in again to carry on.
signIn.providerFailedBody: Nothing was changed. Try {{provider}} again, or sign in with your email and password.

signIn.timedOutBody_other: {{organisation}} signs people out after {{count}} days without use. Sign in again to carry on.

register.title: Create your account
register.intro: Next, we email you a code to check the address is yours.
register.name: Full name
register.ruleNote: That is the only rule. When you submit, we also check the password has not appeared in a known data breach.

register.limitedTitle: Too many sign-ups from this network
register.failedTitle: Creating your account did not work
register.failedBody: Something went wrong on the way. Try again in a moment.

devices.title: Signed in on
devices.intro: Each device is listed as it described itself when it signed in, with the network address it used. Soirely cannot check either, or tell where a device is. Sign out any you do not recognise.
devices.listLabel: Devices signed in to this account
devices.checkBody: It signed in on {{started}} from {{ip}} and was last used {{used}}. Soirely cannot check that it is the device you have in mind. You stay signed in here.
devices.checkWarning: Whoever has it is signed out
devices.passwordAdvice: If somebody else may have it, change your password as well; that signs out every other device.
devices.signInAgain: It has to sign in again before it can carry on, so first check that nobody is using it at an event.
devices.unknownDevice: A device that did not name itself
devices.unknownAddress: an address it did not give
devices.failedTitle: The devices could not be listed
devices.failedBody: This is about reaching the API rather than about your account. Nothing has changed.
devices.endFailedTitle: That device was not signed out
devices.endFailedBody: Nothing has changed. Try again, and check the list afterwards.
devices.everywhereHint: Every device except this one. Asks you to confirm it is you first.
devices.everywhereBody_one: This signs out your other device, whoever has it. This device stays signed in.
devices.everywhereBody_other: This signs out your {{count}} other devices, whoever has them. This device stays signed in.
devices.everywhereSelf_one: Soirely cannot tell whether the device listed is this one, so this signs it out whichever it is. You will sign in again straight after.
devices.everywhereSelf_other: Soirely cannot tell which of these is this device, so this signs out all {{count}}, including this one. You will sign in again straight after.
devices.everywhereWhy: So that nobody who picks up this device can do this without you.
devices.everywhereCodeHelp: From your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes. Two-factor protects this the way it protects signing in.
devices.everywhereCodeBlank: Enter a code from your app, or a recovery code.
devices.everywherePasswordWrong: That is not your password. Try again, or reset it by email.
devices.everywhereCodeWrong: That code did not work. Enter the code your app shows now, or an unused recovery code.
devices.everywhereProvider: You sign in with {{provider}}, so confirm with {{provider}} instead.
devices.everywhereProviderConfirmed: {{provider}} confirmed it is you. Enter the code to carry on.
devices.everywhereProviderFailed: {{provider}} did not confirm it is you, so nothing was signed out. Try again.
devices.everywhereWarning_one: Whoever has it is signed out
devices.everywhereWarning_other: Whoever has them is signed out
devices.everywhereWarningBody_one: It has to sign in again before it can carry on.
devices.everywhereWarningBody_other: They have to sign in again before they can carry on.
devices.everywhereDone_one: Your other device is signed out.
devices.everywhereDone_other: Your {{count}} other devices are signed out.
devices.everywhereNone: No other devices were signed in.
devices.everywhereLimitedBody: Try again at {{time}}. Nothing was signed out.
devices.everywhereLimitedSoon: Wait a moment, then try again. Nothing was signed out.
devices.everywhereFailedBody: This is about reaching the API rather than about your account. Try again.

verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.intro: We sent a code to {{address}}. Enter it here to show the address is yours.
verifyEmail.wrong: That code does not match. Check the newest email from Soirely and try again.
verifyEmail.resendNote: A new code replaces the last one.
verifyEmail.expiredBody: Codes only work for a while. Send a new one and use the code in the newest email.
verifyEmail.exhaustedBody: That code no longer works. Send a new one to carry on.
verifyEmail.wrongAddressBody: and create your account again with the right one.
verifyEmail.registerAgain: Register again with the right one
verifyEmail.doneBody: {{address}} is confirmed. Next, a few details so your team knows who is who.

verifyEmail.failedBody: Something went wrong on the way. Try again in a moment.
verifyEmail.codeBlank: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.

verifyPhone.resendNote: A new code replaces the last one.

verifyPhone.exhaustedBody: That code no longer works. Send a new one to carry on.
verifyPhone.failedBody: Something went wrong on the way. Try again in a moment.
verifyPhone.cantGetTexts: Can't get texts on this number?
verifyPhone.doneBody: Soirely can reach you on {{number}} if something goes wrong on the night.
verifyPhone.doneBodyAlternative: {{number}} is verified. It stays an alternative number until you make it primary in Account.
verifyPhone.changeNotice: Your current number keeps working until the new one is verified.
verifyPhone.numberHelp: Choose the country code, then type the number any way you like.
verifyPhone.tooShort: That number looks too short for {{country}}. Check it and try again.
verifyPhone.tooLong: That number looks too long for {{country}}. Check it and try again.
verifyPhone.taken: That number is already linked to another account. Your current number is unchanged.
verifyPhone.send: Text a code to this number
verifyPhone.introWhatsApp: We sent a code to your WhatsApp on {{number}}.
verifyPhone.introFallback: WhatsApp didn't reach you, so we texted it to {{number}}.
verifyPhone.introChosen: We texted the same code to {{number}}. The one on WhatsApp works too.
verifyPhone.wrongWhatsApp: That code does not match. Check the newest WhatsApp message from Soirely and try again.
verifyPhone.textInsteadFailed: The text could not be sent. Try again in a moment.

noOrganisation.nameHelp: Your team and guests see this name. You can rename it later.

orgGeneral.name: Name

orgGeneral.saved: Saved. Everyone in {{name}} sees the new details on their next screen.
orgGeneral.contactInvalid: That does not look like an email address. Check it has an @ and a domain.

orgGeneral.refused: Nothing was saved. Your role does not include the permission this needs.

completeProfile.title: A few details
completeProfile.intro: So the people you work with know who is who.
completeProfile.name: Full name
completeProfile.nameBlank: Add your name to carry on.
completeProfile.organisationHelp: Your events belong to it. You can rename it later.
completeProfile.organisationBlank: Add your organisation's name to carry on.
completeProfile.organisationOrInvitation: Name your organisation, or accept an invitation above.
completeProfile.invitationsWaiting_one: You have an invitation waiting. Accept it to join that organisation, or start your own below.
completeProfile.invitationsWaiting_other: You have {{count}} invitations waiting. Accept one to join that organisation, or start your own below.
completeProfile.invitationsJoined: You do not need to start an organisation now.
completeProfile.invitationsNone: Nothing is waiting. Name your organisation below.
completeProfile.joinedGoesThere: Save and continue takes you there.
completeProfile.joinedSwitchLater: It is in your organisations. You can switch to it later.

forms.emailShape: That does not look like an email address. Check it has an @ and a domain.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.intro: Enter the email you sign in with. If it has an account, we send it a link to set a new password.
recovery.sentBody: If that address has an account, we have sent it a link to set a new password. The link works once.
recovery.nothingBody: Check your spam folder first, then send it again.
recovery.providerNote: Signed up with Google or Apple? Then there is no password to reset, and the email says how you sign in instead.
recovery.gotIt: Got the link? Open it on any device.
recovery.limitedBody: Try again at {{time}}. Any link already sent still works.
recovery.failedBody: Something went wrong on the way. Try again in a moment.
recovery.signsOut: Setting it signs you out on every other device. This one stays signed in.
recovery.doneBody: You are signed in on this device and signed out everywhere else. We have emailed {{email}} to say it was changed.
recovery.usedTitle: This link has already been used
recovery.usedBody: If you set a new password with it, sign in with that password. If you did not, send a new link now.
recovery.expiredBody: Reset links only work for a short time. Send a new one and use the newest email.
recovery.invalidBody: It may have been cut off or mistyped. Send a new link and use the newest email.
recovery.codeIntro: Your account uses two-factor, so the reset asks for a code first. Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for {{email}}. Nothing changes until it passes.
recovery.codeRecoveryIntro: One of the codes you saved when you turned on two-factor. Each works once. Nothing changes until it passes.
recovery.nothingChanged: Nothing has changed: your password is the same until a code passes.

twoFactor.title: Enter your code
twoFactor.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for {{email}}.
twoFactor.recoveryIntro: One of the codes you saved when you turned on two-factor. Each works once.
twoFactor.lostBoth: Lost your authenticator and your recovery codes?
twoFactor.codeBlank: Enter the 6-digit code from your app.
twoFactor.recoveryBlank: Enter one of your recovery codes.
twoFactor.codeWrong: That code did not work. Enter the code your app shows now.
twoFactor.recoveryWrong: That recovery code did not work. Check it against your saved list.
twoFactor.recoveryUsed: That recovery code has already been used. Try another one from your list.
twoFactor.pausedBody: Code entry is paused until {{time}}. Then enter the code your app shows at that moment.

twoFactorCard.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactorCard.offIntro: Asks for a code from an authenticator app every time you sign in, whether with your password, Google or Apple. Your account holds your clients’ guest lists; this keeps a stolen password from being enough.
twoFactorCard.onIntro: Every sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app, with your password, Google or Apple.
twoFactorCard.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app
twoFactorCard.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactorCard.cantScan: Can’t scan it? Enter this key in the app instead.
twoFactorCard.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
twoFactorCard.setupWrong: That code does not match. Check the app was set up with the key above, then enter the code it shows now.
twoFactorCard.staysOff: Two-factor stays off until the code matches, so a setup mistake cannot lock you out.
twoFactorCard.saveIntro: If you lose your authenticator, each of these signs you in once. This is the only time they are shown.
twoFactorCard.copiedAll: All {{count}} codes are on your clipboard.
twoFactorCard.savedThem: I have saved these codes somewhere safe
twoFactorCard.finishLocked: Two-factor is on. Confirm you have saved the codes to leave this step.
twoFactorCard.finishReady: Two-factor is on. Finish to go back to Security.
twoFactorCard.newWarningBody: New codes replace every code you have now, used or not, as soon as they are made.
twoFactorCard.offBody: Enter a code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
twoFactorCard.offBlank: Enter a code from your app, or a recovery code.
twoFactorCard.offWrong: That code did not work. Enter the code your app shows now, or an unused recovery code.
twoFactorCard.offEmail: We will email {{email}} to say it was turned off.
twoFactorCard.failedBody: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
twoFactorCard.keptByRule: {{organisation}} requires two-factor, so you cannot turn it off.

passwordCard.title: Password
passwordCard.intro: Used with your email to sign in. Changing it signs out your other devices; this one stays signed in.
passwordCard.wrongCurrent: That is not your current password. Try again, or reset it by email.
passwordCard.same: That is already your password. Choose a different one.
passwordCard.pausedBody: Try again at {{time}}. Nothing was changed.
passwordCard.pausedSoon: Wait a moment, then try again. Nothing was changed.
passwordCard.signsOut: Saving signs out your other devices; this one stays signed in.
passwordCard.emailed: We will email {{email}} to say it was changed.
passwordCard.done_zero: Password changed. No other device was signed in.
passwordCard.done_one: Password changed. Your other device is signed out.
passwordCard.done_other: Password changed. Your {{count}} other devices are signed out.
passwordCard.failedBody: Your password could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
passwordCard.setRest: You sign in with {{provider}}. Add a password so you can also sign in with your email if you ever lose that {{provider}} account.
passwordCard.setCodeIntro: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}} to make sure it's you.
passwordCard.setCodeBlank: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
passwordCard.setCodeWrong: That code did not match. Check the newest email from Soirely and try again.
passwordCard.setCodeExpired: This code has expired. Send a new one.
passwordCard.setCodeSpent: That code no longer works. Send a new one.
passwordCard.setCodeNote: Adding a password needs this, so someone using this device without you can't add one.
passwordCard.setSendFailed: The code could not be sent. Check your connection, then send a new one.
passwordCard.setEmailed: We will email {{email}} to say a password was added.
passwordCard.added: Password added. You can sign in with it or with {{provider}}.

waysCard.title: Ways to sign in
waysCard.intro: Any one of these signs you in to {{email}}. Linking or unlinking asks you to confirm it's you, and we email your verified addresses each time.
waysCard.last: {{provider}} is your only way to sign in, so it can't be removed. Set a password or link another account before removing this one.
waysCard.linkedNext: Next time, sign in with {{provider}} as {{address}}, or as before. We emailed your verified addresses to say so.
waysCard.linkedNextPlain: Next time, sign in with {{provider}}, or as before. We emailed your verified addresses to say so.
waysCard.unlinkedDone: {{provider}} is unlinked. Devices signed in with it are signed out.
waysCard.unlinkedNext: You can link it again here at any time. We emailed your verified addresses to say so.
waysCard.taken: That {{provider}} account is already linked to another Soirely account.
waysCard.takenNext: Nothing changed. To use it here, unlink it from that account first, or link a different {{provider}} account.
waysCard.lastRefused: Set a password or link another account before removing this one.
waysCard.providerFailed: {{provider}} didn't finish, so nothing changed. Try again.
waysCard.providerRefused: That {{provider}} account isn't the one linked here, or it was signed in too long ago. Try again.
waysCard.proofExpired_one: Your {{provider}} sign-in was more than a minute ago, so nothing has changed yet. Continue with {{provider}} again to carry on.
waysCard.proofExpired_other: Your {{provider}} sign-in was more than {{count}} minutes ago, so nothing has changed yet. Continue with {{provider}} again to carry on.
waysCard.failedBody: That didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.
waysCard.proveLink_one: To link {{provider}}, confirm it's you. You won't be asked again for a minute.
waysCard.proveLink_other: To link {{provider}}, confirm it's you. You won't be asked again for {{count}} minutes.
waysCard.proveUnlink_one: To unlink {{provider}}, confirm it's you. You won't be asked again for a minute.
waysCard.proveUnlink_other: To unlink {{provider}}, confirm it's you. You won't be asked again for {{count}} minutes.
waysCard.passwordWrong: That is not your password. Try again, or reset it by email.
waysCard.codeBlank: Enter a code from your app, or a recovery code.
waysCard.codeHelp: From your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
waysCard.codeKeepsSignIn_one: A wrong code doesn't send you back to {{provider}}. Your {{provider}} sign-in lasts a minute.
waysCard.codeKeepsSignIn_other: A wrong code doesn't send you back to {{provider}}. Your {{provider}} sign-in lasts {{count}} minutes.
waysCard.codeWrong: That code did not work. Check your app and try again.
waysCard.linkNote: Next, {{provider}} opens so you can choose the account to link. Its address doesn't have to match {{email}}.
waysCard.proveWithProvider: You sign in with {{provider}}, so confirm with {{provider}} instead.
waysCard.confirmBody: You'll no longer be able to sign in with {{provider}} as {{address}}.
waysCard.confirmBodyPlain: You'll no longer be able to sign in with {{provider}}.
waysCard.stillPassword: You can still sign in with your password.
waysCard.stillProvider: You can still sign in with {{provider}}.
waysCard.confirmWarning: Devices signed in with {{provider}} are signed out
waysCard.confirmEmailed: We email every verified address on your account to say {{provider}} was unlinked.
waysCard.keptByRule: A rule set by {{organisation}}: everyone in it signs in with Google or Apple, so your last one cannot be removed.
waysCard.keptByRuleNext: Link {{other}} first if you want to unlink {{provider}}.

timeZone.title: Time zone

timeZone.unset: Not set: times reach you in UTC
timeZone.help: Type a city, a country or an offset, then pick from the list. Now: {{now}}.
timeZone.nowUnset: not set, so times reach you in UTC
timeZone.noneMatch: No time zone matches “{{typed}}”. Try a city, a country or an offset like UTC+01.
timeZone.choose: Choose a time zone from the list.
timeZone.chooseNoMatch: Choose a time zone from the list. Nothing matches “{{typed}}”.
timeZone.refused: That time zone isn’t one we know, so nothing was saved. Choose one from the list.
timeZone.failed: Your time zone could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
timeZone.saved: Time zone changed to {{zone}}. Times in your emails now use it.

lostTwoFactor.startTitle: Get back in without your authenticator
lostTwoFactor.startIntro: For when you have lost your authenticator app and your recovery codes.
lostTwoFactor.step1: We send a code to {{email}}, and one to {{phone}} if your number is verified.
lostTwoFactor.step3: An owner or admin of {{organisations}} confirms it’s you. You stay signed out until they do.
lostTwoFactor.startNote: When they confirm, two-factor is turned off, every session ends, and you sign in again. Every step is emailed to you.
lostTwoFactor.limitedBody: You can ask 3 times a day. Try again {{when}}.
lostTwoFactor.nobodyIntro: Nobody in your organisation can confirm this. Contact Soirely support.
lostTwoFactor.codesIntro: We sent a code to {{email}} and another to {{phone}}. You need both.
lostTwoFactor.sentFallback: WhatsApp didn’t reach you, so we texted it to {{number}}
lostTwoFactor.sentChosen: Texted to {{number}}: the same code as on WhatsApp
lostTwoFactor.emailBlank: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
lostTwoFactor.phoneBlank: Enter the 6-digit code from the text.
lostTwoFactor.emailWrong: That code does not match. Check the newest email from Soirely and try again.
lostTwoFactor.phoneWrong: That code does not match. Check the newest text from Soirely and try again.
lostTwoFactor.phoneWrongWhatsApp: That code does not match. Check the newest WhatsApp message from Soirely and try again.
lostTwoFactor.resendNote: New codes replace the last ones.
lostTwoFactor.textInsteadFailed: That code can’t be texted now. Send new codes.
lostTwoFactor.expiredBody: Codes only work for a while. Send new ones and use the codes in the newest email and {{message}}.
lostTwoFactor.expiredBodyEmailOnly: Codes only work for a while. Send a new one and use the code in the newest email.
lostTwoFactor.exhaustedBody: Those codes no longer work. Send new ones to carry on.
lostTwoFactor.waitingIntro: We’ve asked the owners and admins of {{organisations}} to confirm it’s you. One answer is enough.
lostTwoFactor.endsBy: If nobody answers by {{when}}, the request ends.
lostTwoFactor.stayOut: You stay signed out until somebody answers. We’ll email {{email}} either way.
lostTwoFactor.replacedTitle: A newer request replaced this one
lostTwoFactor.replacedIntro: A newer request was started on another device. Start again to ask from here.
lostTwoFactor.replacedNote: Starting again sends new codes here and ends the request on the other device. It counts as one of your 3 requests a day.
lostTwoFactor.cancelledIntro: Nothing changed. Two-factor is still on.
lostTwoFactor.approvedIntro: Somebody in {{organisations}} confirmed it was you. Every session you had has ended. Sign in, then set it up again.
lostTwoFactor.approvedIntroNobody: Somebody in your organisation confirmed it was you. Every session you had has ended. Sign in, then set it up again.
lostTwoFactor.turnedDownIntro: Two-factor is still on, so you can’t sign in without it. Ask an owner or admin of {{organisations}}, or contact Soirely support.
lostTwoFactor.endedIntro: Nobody answered within 7 days. Two-factor is still on. You can ask again.
lostTwoFactor.failedBody: Something went wrong on the way. Try again in a moment.
lostTwoFactor.setupIntro: Two-factor was turned off to let you back in. Set it up again so a password alone can’t open your account.
lostTwoFactor.notNowNote: You can set it up any time in Settings › Security.
lostTwoFactor.notMeIntro: This cancels any request to get into your account without two-factor that is still waiting, and signs out every session.
lostTwoFactor.notMeDone: Any request that was waiting is cancelled, and every session is signed out. If somebody else knows your password, change it when you next sign in.
lostTwoFactor.notMeBroken: That link doesn’t work. Open it again from the newest email about your account.
lostTwoFactor.limitedBodyLater: You can ask 3 times a day. Try again later.

recoveryRequests.cardNote: Only owners and admins see this. A request leaves it once somebody answers or it ends.
recoveryRequests.title: Asked to turn off two-factor
recoveryRequests.intro: They lost their authenticator and their recovery codes, and stay signed out until somebody answers. One answer from an owner or admin is enough. Approve only if you’re sure it’s them, for example by calling them on a number you already have.
recoveryRequests.provedBoth: Proved with codes to their email and phone
recoveryRequests.provedEmail: Proved with a code to their email (no verified phone)
recoveryRequests.provedBothOwn: Proved with codes to your email and phone
recoveryRequests.provedEmailOwn: Proved with a code to your email (no verified phone)
recoveryRequests.own: This is your own request. Somebody else in {{organisations}} has to answer it.
recoveryRequests.approveBody: Every session they have ends. They sign in again with their password, Google or Apple, and are asked to set up two-factor again.
recoveryRequests.turnDownBody: Two-factor stays on, and they’re emailed that the request was turned down.
recoveryRequests.approvedNext: They’re emailed now, and every session they had has ended.
recoveryRequests.turnedDownNext: Two-factor stays on for them, and they’re emailed.
recoveryRequests.closed: This request has already been answered, or it has ended.

signInRules.title: Sign-in rules
signInRules.intro: For everyone in {{organisation}}. Each rule says who it affects before you turn it on.
signInRules.readIntro: Set by the organisation’s owners. You can read them here; only they can change them.
signInRules.failedLoad: The sign-in rules did not load.
signInRules.saved: Rules saved. Everyone affected has an email saying what changed.
signInRules.failedSave: The rules were not saved. Nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
signInRules.anyMethodMeans: Email and password, Google or Apple. Each person chooses.
signInRules.providerOnlyMeans: Passwords stop working for signing in to {{organisation}}.
signInRules.strandedTitle_one: {{count}} person signs in with a password only
signInRules.strandedTitle_other: {{count}} people sign in with a password only
signInRules.strandedBody: None of them has Google or Apple linked. When you save, each gets an email and, at their next sign-in, a button to link one. Until they do, they can read but not change anything in {{organisation}}.
signInRules.idleTitle: How long a sign-in lasts unused
signInRules.idleIntro: After this long without using Soirely, people are asked to sign in again.
signInRules.twoFactorTitle: Two-factor for people who can manage members, roles, billing or security
signInRules.twoFactorLabel: Require two-factor for people who can manage members, roles, billing or security
signInRules.twoFactorOn: Anyone without two-factor keeps working events and is asked to turn it on before their next change to members, roles, billing or security.
signInRules.twoFactorOff: Off. Anyone with an owner’s or administrator’s password can change members, roles and billing.
signInRules.needsOwnTitle: Turn on two-factor for yourself first
signInRules.needsOwnBody: Then you can require it here.
signInRules.needsOwnProviderTitle: Link Google or Apple for yourself first
signInRules.needsOwnProviderBody: Then you can require it here.
signInRules.effectStranded: {{names}} can read but not change anything until they link Google or Apple. Their password still signs them in.
signInRules.effectProviderOnly: Everyone signs in with Google or Apple. Anyone with one linked who signed in with a password is asked to sign in again with it.
signInRules.effectAnyMethod: People can sign in with their password again.
signInRules.effectIdle_one: Anyone who has not used Soirely for {{count}} day is asked to sign in again, from their next visit.
signInRules.effectIdle_other: Anyone who has not used Soirely for {{count}} days is asked to sign in again, from their next visit.
signInRules.effectNoLimit: Sign-ins last until people sign out.
signInRules.effectTwoFactorOn: People who can manage members, roles, billing or security need two-factor for it. Until they turn it on, only those permissions wait; their events keep working.
signInRules.effectTwoFactorOff: People who can manage members, roles, billing or security can do it without two-factor.
signInRules.effectNothing: Nothing changes. These are the rules in force.
signInRules.emailNote: Everyone affected gets an email saying what changed and why.
signInRules.seeProviderBody: A rule set by {{organisation}}. Use the Google or Apple button. Until you link one, you can read but not change anything.
signInRules.seeNote: The message names {{organisation}} and the rule, so nobody thinks Soirely is broken. Someone in several organisations sees which one’s rule it is.
signInRules.noChanges: No changes yet. These are the rules every organisation starts with.
signInRules.valueAnyMethod: Any method: email and password, Google or Apple
signInRules.valueIdle_one: Sign-ins end after {{count}} day without use
signInRules.valueIdle_other: Sign-ins end after {{count}} days without use
signInRules.valueNoLimit: Sign-ins last until you sign out
signInRules.valueTwoFactor: Two-factor required for people who can manage members, roles, billing or security
signInRules.unlinkedTitle: Read-only until you link Google or Apple
signInRules.unlinkedBody: {{organisation}} now signs in with Google or Apple only. Your password still works for now, but until you link one of them you can read but not change anything in {{organisation}}.
signInRules.gateBody: {{organisation}} asks people who can manage members, roles, billing or security to use two-factor. Until you turn it on, those wait. Your events keep working.
signInRules.limitApplies_one: For you, sign-ins end after {{count}} day without use: {{organisation}}’s rule, the shortest of your organisations.
signInRules.limitApplies_other: For you, sign-ins end after {{count}} days without use: {{organisation}}’s rule, the shortest of your organisations.
signInRules.twoFactorCovered: Covered by two-factor for everyone, below.
signInRules.everyoneOn: Everyone needs two-factor to open anything in {{organisation}}.
signInRules.everyoneOff: Off. Members sign in without two-factor unless the rule above asks it of them.
signInRules.everyoneWithoutBody_one: When you save, they get an email. They have until {{deadline}} to turn it on. After that they can’t open anything in {{organisation}} until they do.
signInRules.everyoneWithoutBody_other: When you save, each gets an email. They have until {{deadline}} to turn it on. After that they can’t open anything in {{organisation}} until they do.
signInRules.effectEveryoneOn: Everyone needs two-factor. Anyone without it is emailed and has 7 days to turn it on.
signInRules.effectEveryoneOff: Two-factor is no longer required of everyone.
signInRules.overdueTitle: Turn on two-factor to carry on
signInRules.overdueBody: {{organisation}} requires two-factor, and the time to turn it on has passed.
signInRules.overdueElsewhere: Your other organisations and single-event access are not affected.

ownership.title: Ownership and leaving
ownership.transferNote: Hand {{organisation}} to another member. Asks for your password first.
ownership.transferBody: The new owner can change billing, members, roles and these settings, and can delete {{organisation}}. You become an Administrator.
ownership.passwordWrong: That is not your password. Nothing was changed. Try again, or reset it by email.
ownership.passwordWhy: So that nobody who picks up this device can give {{organisation}} away.
ownership.code: Code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code
ownership.codeBlank: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
ownership.bothEmailed: You and {{name}} each get an email saying it happened.
ownership.transferred: {{name}} is now the owner of {{organisation}}. You are an Administrator. You both have an email saying so.
ownership.leaveNote: You lose access to its events. Everything you made stays with {{organisation}}.
ownership.leaveBody: You lose access to {{organisation}} as soon as you leave.
ownership.onlyOwnerBody: You are the only owner. Make somebody else an owner, then you can leave.
ownership.deleteNote: Deletes every event, guest and member record in it.
ownership.deleteWindow: This deletes it for everybody now. Soirely support can restore it until {{deadline}}; after that it is gone for good.
ownership.deleteMismatch: Type {{organisation}} exactly as shown to delete it.
ownership.deleteExactly: Exactly as it is written, accents included.
